shots.content: Inside a meeting room, a rectangular conference table stands between a presentation screen and a glass door, with windows along one side; a clear walkway runs opposite the window. A man in a white shirt sits in the door-side walkway seat and begins the discussion about the unusual case. A woman in a yellow shirt sits in the screen-side window seat. A man in a purple shirt sits in the door-side window seat. There is one empty place.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the glass door end, looking along the conference table toward the presentation screen, with both window-side seats and both walkway-side seats and the presentation screen in frame.

shots.content: A man in a blue shirt enters and sits in the empty place. He offers to leave, but a man in a white shirt asks him to stay and assist with the case.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the window side, centered on the two adjacent walkway-side seats.

shots.content: A man in a white shirt asks a man in a purple shirt to proceed with the account, and he answers with the details of the case.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the conference table.
